title: Blaq ORB MTF Strategy
summary: Opening Range Breakout strategy for ES/NQ futures that filters entries through Day, 4H, 1H, and 30M 200 EMA continuity, relative volume, and optional support/resistance context. Default risk uses ORB midpoint stop, 2R target, hybrid trailing exits, max daily loss, and max trades per day.
requiredConditions: MTF 200 EMA continuity aligns with trade direction when enabled
EMA slope aligns with trade direction when enabled
Relative volume exceeds SMA(20) times configured multiplier when enabled
Entry trigger mode fires from ORB breakout, 200 EMA cross, continuation, or combined mode
Risk plan satisfies midpoint stop, daily loss, max trades, and position-size rules
Sigma approval gate accepts the plan before any execution path

validation.status: Backtests still under review; do not promote to live until out-of-sample validation is positive.
knownConcerns: ORB midpoint stop may be too tight on noisy opens
MTF filters can reduce trade count and overfit to trend regimes
Relative volume threshold needs instrument-specific validation
Reported positive NQ snapshot is not enough for production approval
